Definition: from G1909 and G4155; to throttle upon, i.e. (figuratively) overgrow:--choke.
BiblicalUsage: Epipnigo means to choke, to throttle upon — and the seed that fell among thorns was choked by them as they sprung up, and it yielded no fruit.
TheologicalSignificance: Cares and riches grow up around the word until it cannot breathe, and the thorns are the picture of a crowded heart.
RelatedTopics: Jesus Christ; Temptation; Fruit of the Spirit
